membership_reproducibility: Document membership can be reconstructed only by re-fetching every exact hash-pinned source object while it remains available; membership is not independently retained.
claim_boundary: A valid attestation reproduces only the registered target-day aggregate shares, channel sums and calibrated final store row from exact source-object and count evidence. It does not prove retained document membership, public identity, extract or full-record redistribution rights, source truth, precision, causation, forecast validity or production authorization.
